conjuncts.title: Every reported check green, on the latest run per check name
No configured reviewer's requested round has stalled
No configured reviewer's round owed at the current head
Every approving reviewer's latest round is an APPROVE at the current head

caveats.text: "Addressed" is APPROXIMATED by a current-head review round, an APPROVE when approval_policy is 'required', and zero unresolved threads. The gate cannot read whether a thread's substance was actually answered. Replying remains the author's obligation.

That a BUILD check exists specifically is NOT asserted -- only that at least one check reported and that every reported check is green on its latest run. An EMPTY rollup FAILS, so absence is a finding here and never a pass; what the gate cannot tell you is WHICH checks reported. Confirm by eye that the one your repository requires is among them.

A reviewer finding with NO thread object -- a suppressed-comments block rendered in the review BODY -- has nothing for the unresolved-threads row to count. Read the review bodies, not only their threads.

notes: could not confirm the default-branch tip declares no exclusion: the default-branch tip refused its declaration (acme/widget@defa017:nen/gates.json: at $, carries 'future_gate', which this build does not read. That object takes version (nen >= 0.1.0), reviewers (nen >= 0.1.0), default_approvers (nen >= 0.1.0), base_reviewers (nen >= 0.1.0), delivery (nen >= 0.1.0), dependabot_carve_out (nen >= 0.7.0), approval_policy (nen >= 0.10.0), round_policy (nen >= 0.11.0), round_quorum (nen >= 0.17.0), checks (nen >= 0.20.0); and any '$'-prefixed annotation. This is nen <VERSION>: a key a newer nen introduced is read only by that nen, so upgrade nen; a misspelling, correct or remove. Refused rather than ignored, so a declared gate is never dropped by a binary that does not know it (zheref/nen#310).) at acme/widget@defa017:nen/gates.json. No declared exclusion was applied; every check counts on CON-32(a).
